rationale: The assistant correctly framed wet plastics as normal, asked the right first checks (rinse aid, residual heat) and landed on the hidden truth: empty rinse aid plus opening the door immediately. It did not fabricate evidence or suggest parts or an engineer. Weaknesses: it never asked which programme was used or mentioned extra dry after the first turn, did not explicitly address the customer's point about all-in-one tablets (the 'fill rinse aid even with all-in-ones' explanation), and the advice to wait until the machine has cooled 30-60 minutes is slightly overstated versus the usual 15-30 minutes or cracking the door ajar.
